command_line:
set -eu
Rscript - "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78563216/inputs/dataset_8ba6e8d3-df90-4138-851f-eac856bc75ef.dat" << 'REOF'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
counts_file <- args[1]

# Read count matrix - try comma first (original CSV format), then tab
first_line <- readLines(counts_file, n=1)
sep <- if (grepl("\t", first_line)) "\t" else ","
cat("Detected separator:", if(sep=="\t") "tab" else "comma", "\n")

counts <- read.table(counts_file, header=TRUE, row.names=1, sep=sep,
                     check.names=FALSE, quote="\"", comment.char="")

cat("Columns:", paste(head(colnames(counts), 10), collapse=", "), "...\n")

# Select DMSO and CBD_IC50 columns
dmso_cols <- c("3_1", "3_2", "3_3")
cbd_cols <- c("7_1", "7_2", "7_3")

cat("Looking for DMSO cols:", paste(dmso_cols, collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("Found:", paste(dmso_cols[dmso_cols %in% colnames(counts)], collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("Not found:", paste(dmso_cols[!dmso_cols %in% colnames(counts)], collapse=", "), "\n")

stopifnot(all(dmso_cols %in% colnames(counts)))
stopifnot(all(cbd_cols %in% colnames(counts)))

counts_sub <- counts[, c(dmso_cols, cbd_cols)]

condition <- factor(c(rep("DMSO", 3), rep("CBD_IC50", 3)),
                    levels=c("DMSO", "CBD_IC50"))
colData <- data.frame(condition=condition,
                     row.names=colnames(counts_sub))

library(DESeq2)

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=counts_sub,
                              colData=colData,
                              design=~condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)

res <- results(dds, contrast=c("condition", "CBD_IC50", "DMSO"))
res <- res[order(res$padj), ]

write.table(as.data.frame(res), file="deseq_results.tsv", sep="\t",
            row.names=TRUE, col.names=NA, quote=FALSE)
REOF
